title: Review deadlines met, year by year
question: Has the share of building permit reviews finishing on time changed over the years?
finding: The share of first reviews within the 30-calendar-day benchmark was lowest for permits filed in 2021 (11%) and highest in 2025 (73%). Recent years include only reviews that have already finished, which flatters them.
how: Finished review rows grouped by the year the permit was filed; the deadline flag is the City’s.
limits: PermitSF announced these targets in May 2025. Earlier rows are retrospective comparisons. The City set a goal of meeting each calendar-day target on 75% of applicable reviews. Its April 2024 housing guidance used business days, different start events and unit-count thresholds. Permits filed recently are still in review; the slowest of them have not finished and are not yet counted. Changes in the mix of permits (more electronic filings, fewer large projects) move these shares without any change in effort.
